relationshipReview.rationale: Reviewed each of the three exact owner-selected event vectors against the full 295-order current library and the other two finalized peer mappings. Coverage includes all 78 generated children and the retained noncatalog parent. The reports contain 297 comparisons each, no exact duplicate and no overlap between selected peers. The five meaningful relationships below retain every supplied original with distinct finite-event versus broader-guide scope. Remaining comparisons have zero shared issues and qualify only for the maintained none policy. This approval changes no historical source or overlap authority.

insertionReview.rationale: Approve all three finite events/storylines with timeline start 2023. The factual sources establish the spring death/tribute storyline, summer Contest saga and late-year Gang War crossover. Approve editorial same-year order The Death of Ms. Marvel, Contest of Chaos, Gang War before the existing 2024 Fall/Rise event. This does not claim an exact in-universe total chronology, alter the supplied within-list order or classify a broad character run as an event.
